segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the toner controls shine and sebum without feeling greasy, and several say it does not dry them out despite the oil control.
segments.dry: Some with dry or dry/normal skin found it too drying and stripping even under moisturizer, while others with dry skin say it left skin soft without irritation.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including combo-oily and combo-sensitive, generally describe it as balancing and gentle enough for regular use on their T-zone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say it is gentle, non-irritating and even usable with eczema, but others report burning, stinging, peeling or flare-ups on sensitive skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer used it postpartum to address clogged pores and dullness and reports her complexion looked its best after regular use.

concerns.aging: One postpartum reviewer used it as her only skincare step and reports her complexion looking its best; no other aging-specific claims are made.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it does not dry them out and even adds hydration before moisturizer, but multiple others, including some with dry skin, report it made their skin noticeably drier or flaky.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report reduced redness in the T-zone or from past acne with regular use, and one notes no new redness or dry spots after two weeks; one reviewer says it caused redness and irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer warns that daily use can strip the barrier and increase sebum/breakouts if overused, recommending alternating with another toner; one reviewer describes burning and peeling suggesting barrier irritation.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of acne scars, dark spots and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation with consistent use over weeks; one reviewer says it did nothing for her scarring.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including many with acne-prone or cystic acne, report fewer breakouts, smaller pores and clearer skin, often within one to four weeks; several dissent, describing immediate breakouts, purging that never resolved, or no improvement at all.
concerns.oiliness: Several oily and combination reviewers report reduced shine and 'gunk' around the T-zone without feeling stripped; one reviewer says it made her skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Clears breakouts and shrinks pores over time
Spray format convenient for body use
Stinging or burning sensation on application
Good value for price and longevity of bottle

extraits.texte: I love several other toners and essences from CosRX so wanted to give a bottle of this a go as I do have sensitive acne and blemish prone skin. This was unfortunately super drying for my skin, ironically as the most watery toner I've ever tried, and it did not suit my dry skin type at all - I normally use toners to hydrate my full body's skin before moisturizing, and this just left me so dry that even following with a moisturizer I love and trust was noticeably feeling a lot less soft and I felt dry again much quicker. I tried to make this work by trying every body moisturizer I had, but it just wasn't working. So I actually was ready to dump with out, but decided to mix this with another toner that doesn't have active ingredients in it so I could use it on my feet before putting vaseline over them in hopes my feet wouldn't suffer so much like my body's skin. I can't use this as a toner on my body like every toner I have used before, so it is definitely not suited to my skin's needs sadly. I like enough products by this brand that I don't think I will stop using anything else I've enjoyed by them because of this, but as this is the 2nd product I do not enjoy by them, I will just be sticking to what I like rather than try to experiment with anything else now.

extraits.titre: Doesn't do anything but dry out skin
extraits.texte: I bought this because it doesn't have alcohol in it, and I also have large pores and blackheads on my T-zone so the AHA/BHA properties are a must for me. Do NOT get this in your eyes. Very drying and harsh, not a fan. *I have combo oily sensitive skin.*

I have been using the product RELIGIOUSLY for a year. i have acne prone, oily, sensitive skin and this is gentle enough to not irritate me but also works well to keep acne at bay. I wouldnt say it clears pores, but it most definitely keeps new blemishes from appearing. I used to get cystic acne on my jaw for years, i have had virtually no painful cystic acne since using this. Absoultely worth it.

I have sensitive skin and eczema, and I also have acne. It feels impossible to tackle both problems at the same time. This is the gentlest non-prescription solution I've been able to find for my acne that doesn't trigger my eczema. I use it once every other day to avoid drying my skin out too much and it's mostly kept my acne at bay, other than little hormonal breakouts once a month.

A staple in my skincare. Combo skins best friend is bha ,it's perfect for when my skin is acting up shapes it back into shape. Doesn't irritate (no toner should) regardless it's super gentle but yet powerful. Helps get rid of uneven tone in time and helps those hormonal flare ups. Seriously can't go wrong with this. Disclaimer I don't use it everyday only when needed. But can be used as an everyday one wouldn't recommend that because it can bring out more underlying blemishes from using it too often because the aha drives it out of the skin so you could damage skin barrier and dry it out resulting in more sebum production (aka pimples) so switch it up with another toner on other days to prevent

extraits.titre: Cleared up my skin and helped ease my hyperpigmentation
extraits.texte: I bought this toner about 4 weeks ago and I absolutely love it. I have sensitive, combo, acne prone skin and its cleared up my clogged pores. It's even helped to reduce and get rid of my occasional cystic acne bumps. I was terrified of chemical exfoliants, but after I slowly introduced this into my routine every other day, I saw amazing results. I use it every day now and have no irritation. My post inflammatory hyperpigmentation from my older acne is fading too. I highly recommend this toner.

extraits.titre: Calming and refreshing for combo sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I use this after cleansing and prior to serums. It doesnt seem like much at first but with consistent use it makes a difference in the redness in the tzone area and acne. I have hormonal cystic acne and when I spray directly and concentrate with blotting with cotton pad at the start of something developing, often times the next day it is reduced in appearance or gone. If a troublesome area is particular, I also add Mario Badescu drying lotion and it goes away before it becomes raised. Prevention is key for acne scarring so this is now an essential step for me morning and night. I wish I had this product when I was younger!
